'''Hydrochloric acid''' was a [[Acid/Legends|toxin]] expelled by the mutated [[orlax]] [[Red (orlax)|Red]] during an [[CI-004 Incident|outbreak]] of [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun's]] [[CI-004 Research Facility]], in [[3627 BBY]].<ref name="Op">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=operation|The Troubling Nature of Progress}}</ref>
